cases.sentence: Буду славить тебя, Господи, от всего ___
cases.translation: I will praise You, Lord, with all my heart
cases.explain: The phrase от всего (from all) takes the genitive case.

cases.translation: I will be glad and rejoice in You
cases.explain: The verb радоваться (to rejoice) takes a prepositional phrase with о (about).

cases.sentence: Враги мои обратились вспять, пошатнулись они пред ___ и погибли
cases.translation: My enemies turned back, they stumbled before You and were destroyed
cases.explain: The preposition пред (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Ты ты воссел на троне творить правый ___
cases.translation: You sat on the throne to execute righteous judgment
cases.explain: Суд is the direct object of творить (to execute), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Но Господь владычествует вовек, Он для ___ воздвиг свой престол
cases.translation: But the Lord reigns forever; He has established His throne for judgment
cases.explain: The phrase для суда (for the sake of judgment) uses the genitive case after для.

cases.translation: The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed
cases.explain: Прибежище (refuge) with the verb быть (to be) takes the dative case to indicate who the refuge is for.

cases.sentence: Будут уповать на Тебя те, кто знает имя ___
cases.translation: Those who know Your name will put their trust in You
cases.explain: The direct object имя Твое (Your name) takes the accusative case after знает (know).

cases.translation: The Lord has made Himself known as a righteous judge
cases.explain: Судья is a predicate nominative, following the verb открылся (made Himself known).

reading.ru: Буду славить тебя, Господи, от всего сердца, расскажу о всех твоих чудесах, буду радоваться и торжествовать о тебе, в песнях имя твое прославлю, Всевышний.
reading.question: What does the psalmist promise to do in this verse?
options: Praise God with his whole heart and recount all His wonders
reading.correct: Praise God with his whole heart and recount all His wonders
reading.explain: The psalmist declares буду славить тебя... расскажу о всех твоих чудесах (I will praise You... I will tell of all Your wonders).

reading.ru: Ты поддержал меня в правой тяжбе, ты воссел на троне творить правый суд.
reading.question: What has God done for the psalmist?
options: Upheld him in his righteous cause and established justice
reading.correct: Upheld him in his righteous cause and established justice
reading.explain: The text says Ты поддержал меня в правой тяжбе, ты воссел на троне творить правый суд (You upheld me in my just cause, You sit on the throne to execute righteous judgment).

reading.ru: Национы упали в яму, которую сами выкопали, их ноги запутались в сети, которую они скрыли.
reading.question: What happens to the wicked according to this verse?
options: They fall into their own traps and snares
reading.correct: They fall into their own traps and snares
reading.explain: The text describes как они упали в яму... их ноги запутались в сети (they fell into the pit... their feet became entangled in the net).

reading.ru: Но не навсегда забыт будет нищий, и надеждам страдальца не вечно гибнуть.
reading.question: What does God promise regarding the poor and suffering?
options: The poor will not be forgotten forever and the hope of the afflicted will not perish
The poor will never find help
reading.correct: The poor will not be forgotten forever and the hope of the afflicted will not perish
reading.explain: The text promises не навсегда забыт будет нищий, и надеждам страдальца не вечно гибнуть (the poor will not be forgotten forever, nor shall the hope of the afflicted perish).

reading.ru: Господь справедлив и любит праведный суд.
reading.question: What are two characteristics of God mentioned in this verse?
options: God is just and loves righteous judgment
God is harsh and demands punishment
reading.correct: God is just and loves righteous judgment
reading.explain: The text states Господь справедлив и любит праведный суд (The Lord is just and loves righteous judgment).

reading.ru: Вославлю Господа, праведен он, воспою хвалу имени Господа Всевышнего.
reading.question: What will the psalmist do to glorify God?
options: Give thanks to God and sing praises to His name
reading.correct: Give thanks to God and sing praises to His name
reading.explain: The psalmist declares Вославлю Господа... воспою хвалу имени Господа (I will thank the Lord... I will sing praise to the Lord's name).
